## dsh-cache-cleaner v0.1.0

First public release. A DeepSeek Harness plugin that finds and removes the
rebuildable caches of DSH itself, its desktop client, and the plugins installed
into a profile — with a settings page, two agent tools, and an HTTP route that
all run the same cleanup engine.

### What it cleans

13 targets in four groups (13 个目标，四组):

| Group | Targets |
| --- | --- |
| DSH core | request-image cache, session projection cache, prepared-shell spill |
| Temp spill | `dsh-subprocess-*`, `dsh-spill-*`, other `dsh-*` temp entries |
| Desktop client | HTTP cache, Code Cache, GPU/shader caches, logs |
| Plugins & updater | updater installer cache, plugin context overview cache, cc-safety-net build cache |

On the author's machine the first launch reported **1.5 GB / 1213 files**, of
which **8.8 MB / 202 files** was older than a week.

### Entry points

- **Settings → 缓存清理 / Cache Cleaner** — rescan, review per-target sizes and
  paths, tick a subset, confirm with a second click.
- **Agent tools** — `cache_scan` and `cache_clean` (`olderThanHours`), so an
  agent can plan a cleanup before running it.
- **HTTP route** — `POST /dsh-cache-cleaner/api/{scan,clean}`, same-origin and
  authenticated through the host's connection trust checks (untrusted requests
  are answered 401).

### Cleaning options

| Option | `olderThanHours` | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 仅 7 天前的 / 7+ days old | `168` | only entries untouched for the last week |
| 全部缓存 / Everything | `null` | every entry, including caches written seconds ago |
| default | omitted | per-target cutoff (temp targets keep entries newer than 6 h) |

### Install

The package is installed by link, not from npm:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/you112358/dsh-cache-cleaner.git
```

then, in a DSH session:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<absolute path to the checkout>
```

The settings page appears under Settings → 缓存清理 / Cache Cleaner; refresh the
page once after installing. Uninstall with
`plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-cache-cleaner`.

### Safety

- Only declared roots are touched (`~/.dsh`, the OS temp directory, the desktop
  client's userData, the updater directory, `~/.cc-safety-net`); sessions,
  attachments, profiles, credentials and client Local Storage are explicitly
  protected.
- Symlinks are never followed. Files held open by the running process are
  reported as skipped, never forced. Deleting a cache only costs a rebuild.

### Checks

`node --check client/client.js`, a host-half import probe, and
`node scripts/check-client.mjs` run in CI on Node 22.
